## NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B API

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B is a large language model by NVIDIA, available on the Venice API as `nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b`. This model is private and no prompt data is stored in any capacity.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B is a fast hybrid Mixture-of-Experts model from NVIDIA with 30B total parameters (3B active), engineered for always-on agents, reasoning, tool use, and structured outputs at high throughput.

### How to use the NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }'
```
